quote: For GPT-4, both zero-shot and few-shot prompting with randomly sampled examples were tested.
Among the collected data, a total of 2, 401 conversations were randomly sampled and annotated using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) with each conversation receiving at least three annotations.
guideline: Annotators were asked to assume themselves as the author of the context posts... and to assume the writer of the target posts as their unfamiliar friends... The annotation schema ranged from "not offensive at all" to "extremely offensive" (range 0 -100) and the annotators are required to provide their confidence rating with the range of 0 -100.
